entries.before: The builder and results described 61 as an unconditional requirement to win confidence.
entries.after: 61 is labeled an absolute seat majority and a planning target. An initial confidence vote depends on votes for and against, with abstention distinguished from opposition.
entries.explanation: A seat-majority target is useful coalition arithmetic but cannot replace the applicable confidence rules. The 2021 government was confirmed 60–59. The same wording correction applies on Results and the homepage.

evidence.title: Basic Law: The Government — initial confidence and government formation

entries.before: The results preparation text said votes for lists below the threshold are shared out.
entries.after: Votes for a list below the threshold are not transferred. Seats are allocated among lists that passed.
entries.explanation: The previous wording could imply that a failed list's votes move to other parties. This correction aligns the preparation and count text with the seat-allocation explanation.

evidence.title: Israel Democracy Institute: How Votes Become Knesset Seats (March 16, 2026)
